databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT entity_id) AS d FROM workspace.mlpab261212.training" 2>&1

databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT entity_id) AS d FROM workspace.mlpab261212.serving" 2>&1

databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS matched FROM workspace.mlpab261212.training t JOIN workspace.mlpab261212.serving s USING(entity_id)" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Check row counts and join overlap

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT
  count(*) AS n,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(t.f1-s.f1) > 1e-4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(t.f2-s.f2) > 1e-4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d2,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(t.f3-s.f3) > 1e-4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d3,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(t.f4-s.f4) > 1e-4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d4,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(t.f5-s.f5) > 1e-4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d5
FROM workspace.mlpab261212.training t
JOIN workspace.mlpab261212.serving s USING(entity_id)" 2>&1

databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT
  t.entity_id, t.f3 AS train_f3, s.f3 AS serve_f3,
  round(s.f3 - t.f3,4) AS diff,
  round(s.f3 / t.f3,4) AS ratio,
  round(t.f3*t.f3,4) AS train_sq,
  round(exp(t.f3),4) AS train_exp
FROM workspace.mlpab261212.training t
JOIN workspace.mlpab261212.serving s USING(entity_id)
ORDER BY t.f3 LIMIT 8" 2>&1

databricks experimental aitools tools query "
SELECT
  max(abs(s.f3 - (exp(t.f3)-1))) AS max_err_expm1,
  max(abs(t.f3 - ln(1+s.f3))) AS max_err_log1p
FROM workspace.mlpab261212.training t
JOIN workspace.mlpab261212.serving s USING(entity_id)" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Verify expm1/log1p relationship across all rows
